observations.start: Legends' Guild entrance and Radimus Erkle; minimum 107 quest points and completion of Family Crest, Heroes' Quest, Shilo Village, Underground Pass and Waterfall Quest.
observations.route: Survey three Kharazi sectors with Radimus notes, recover the bullroarer, summon Gujuo, inspect Ungadulu's fire, smith and bless a gold bowl, fetch sacred water, pass the ancient gates, solve the rune/gem puzzles, rescue Ungadulu, germinate Yommi seeds, make bravery potion, descend to the crystal source, recover and forge the heart crystal, take Echned's dark dagger to Ungadulu for Holy Force, return to the water source, defeat Nezikchened and restore the source, grow and carve the Yommi tree, replace the jungle totem and defeat Nezikchened again, then return the gilded totem to Radimus.
observations.supplies: Estimated 30,000 GP trade bundle: machete, rune axe, lockpick, pickaxe, hammer, rope, 2 gold bars, 3 papyrus and charcoal, 7 gems, SMELL runes, vial of water and two charge-orb spell sets. Gather ardrigal and snake weed as nontradeable sources. Combat loadout must be independently provided.
observations.rewards: Four quest points, Legends' Guild membership and one four-choice Radimus reward of 30,000 XP each in twelve eligible skills. The repeatable skill choice is one package with one producer, shared by the two tracker entries; the final quest conversation does not grant it twice.

pending_reviews: Guide models the long protective Holy Force route; the alternate short evil branch and potential missing protections remain unmodeled.
Pinned helper consolidates some listed requirements (notably Crafting 50) without a distinct route operation, so gate placement and skill boostability need independent live checks.
Some game-world cave coordinates, path durations, outside anvil position and route shortcuts are regional approximations pending in-client replay.

Gold-bowl smithing and blessing, Yommi germination/growth/cutting, undead fragments and three demon fights are success-forecast planned outcomes. Failed attempts, combat consumables and incidental XP must be measured.
The barter price is a static conservative allowance, not live GE pricing; world map ferry costs or alternative travel/teleport options may be missing.
The charge-orb gates use one of two purchased spell sets on each descent. Exact magic XP and any item retention at the doors need confirmation.
The timing of four XP choices relative to final quest completion and special retroactive claims at Radimus should be independently observed.
